description.text: Read the selected worksheets when the employee key resolves and compare resolved fields against their reference values.
Read the selected worksheets once when the run resolves the employee key.

checks.text: Compare each resolved field and review any differences.

outcomes.label: No differences to review
outcomes.then: Continues with the next workflow action.

outcomes.label: Field differs
outcomes.then: Waits for your decision in Logs in both live and dry runs.

outcomes.label: Continue anyway
outcomes.then: Continues after you accept the displayed differences.

outcomes.label: Cancel run
outcomes.then: Cancels the run at the reference review.

description.text: Read the exact email-bound CRM hire record.

checks.text: Split the saved roster's legal and preferred names, and validate the CRM hire values before continuing.

question.title: Choose roster row
question.context: If the exact email is missing or has several matches, Logs asks you to choose and revalidate the saved worksheet and row before reading CRM.

outcomes.label: Waits for you
outcomes.then: Waits for you to resolve it in Logs, then continues.

outcomes.label: Cancel run
outcomes.then: Cancels this run before the next step.

outcomes.label: Finishes
outcomes.then: Continues to the next step.

outcomes.label: CRM data not verified
outcomes.then: CRM hire data could not be verified. Review the record first. The run stops with a failure card.

outcomes.label: CRM data invalid
outcomes.then: CRM hire data is invalid. Check the source fields and overrides. The run stops with a failure card.

outcomes.label: Name parts unclear
outcomes.then: The name cannot be split into first, middle and last. Write it as Last, First Middle, or add the middle name in CRM. The run stops with a failure card.

description.text: Search UCPath for a matching person using the validated hire identity.

checks.text: Resolve a new hire or an existing person from the returned candidates.

outcomes.label: No existing person
outcomes.then: Looks up the I-9 profile before asking you to approve a new hire.

outcomes.label: Existing person confirmed
outcomes.then: Skips I-9 lookup and asks you to approve the existing person's hire.

outcomes.label: Identity needs review
outcomes.then: Keeps the candidates for your hire review; only a new-hire run with no confirmed person looks up I-9.

outcomes.label: Screenshot not saved
outcomes.then: The browser screenshot could not be saved. The run stops with a failure card.

outcomes.label: UCPath search failed
outcomes.then: UCPath search failed. The run stops with a failure card.

outcomes.label: Duplicate search inconsistent
outcomes.then: UCPath’s duplicate search returned conflicting people. The run stops with a failure card.

outcomes.label: Existing person needed
outcomes.then: A concurrent hire needs an existing UCPath person. Check the hire mode. The run stops with a failure card.

description.text: Retain the exact I-9 Lookup result, or the explicit existing-person path that needs no lookup.

outcomes.label: Lookup completed
outcomes.then: Retains the exact child result for the hire review.

outcomes.label: Lookup not required
outcomes.then: Continues to review the existing person's hire findings.

outcomes.label: I-9 lookup unresolved
outcomes.then: The I-9 lookup found nothing for this hire. No profile was created. The run stops with a failure card.

outcomes.label: No profile found
outcomes.then: Plans a new profile and remote record after hire approval.

outcomes.label: Signed
outcomes.then: Checks whether the existing profile and record can be reused for the approved hire.

outcomes.label: Unsigned
outcomes.then: Checks the existing profile and record before creating or reusing the remote record.

outcomes.label: Historical
outcomes.then: Retains the historical profile evidence for the approved hire plan.

outcomes.label: Unable to access
outcomes.then: A new hire cannot pass the reviewed hire check; an approved existing-person hire needs no I-9 creation.

outcomes.label: I-9 lookup unresolved
outcomes.then: The I-9 lookup found nothing for this hire. No profile was created. The run stops with a failure card.

outcomes.label: I-9 Lookup: all finished
outcomes.then: Continues to the next step.

outcomes.label: I-9 Lookup: some failed
outcomes.then: The I-9 lookup did not establish a verified result; the run stops before hire approval.

description.text: Read complete UCPath transaction findings for the proposed hire.
Review the findings and approve the new or existing person hire path.

question.title: Use an existing person

outcomes.label: File as a new hire

outcomes.label: Use an existing person

outcomes.label: Reject and cancel run
outcomes.then: Cancels the run before any I-9 or UCPath change is saved.

outcomes.label: Finishes
outcomes.then: Continues to the next step.

outcomes.then: The UCPath hire could not be verified. The run stops with a failure card.

outcomes.label: Screenshot not saved
